value.title: Académie de Poésie et de Musique
value.extract: The Académie de Poésie et de Musique (French: Académie de poésie et de musique), later renamed the Académie du Palais, was the first Academy in France. It was founded in 1570 under the auspices of Charles IX of France by the poet Jean-Antoine de Baïf and the musician Joachim Thibault de Courville.
